datasets.title: Where does America actually commute?
datasets.blurb: 50+ megaregions drawn from 4 million commuter flows, not state lines

sources.label: Nelson, G.D. & Rae, A. (2016) An Economic Geography of the United States: From Commutes to Megaregions. PLOS ONE 11(11): e0166083
Data: Rae & Nelson, United States Commutes and Megaregions data for GIS (mosaic-regions), Univ. of Sheffield Figshare, doi:10.15131/shef.data.4110156.v5, CC BY 4.0
Counties: US Census Bureau 2023 cartographic boundaries

datasets.notes: Method: the authors took 4.16 million tract-to-tract commuter flows (ACS 2006–2010), ran the Combo community-detection algorithm to group tracts that commute to each other, then refined the result visually into megaregions (Fig. 11 of the paper). This map uses the authors' official tract-built region file (mosaic-regions, detailed) and assigns each 2023 county to the region covering most of its land area (computed in equal-area projection); 49 counties are split across regions with under 60% in one. Region names are the paper's (‘Dalls Ft Worth’ spelling corrected); two regions unnamed in the paper use the authors' later names (Sacagawea, Big Sky), and the later alternative names are in each popup. Alaska and Hawaii were not part of the study. Colours are a 4-colour scheme so neighbouring regions never share a colour; they carry no meaning.

lines.yearNoteLabel: People within 100 km of a scheduled airport

datasets.notes: MODELLED GROWTH, PACED BY SOURCED FLEET SIZE. Counter = routes in this dataset, not world totals. Routes shown per year = airliner fleet × 0.7046 (18,779 routes ÷ 26,653 aircraft in 2014); 1914 = 1 route; 1915–1959 a smooth (monotone log-spline) curve from 1 to the 1960 value (2,114), never below the confirmed milestones active. 22 milestone routes appear in their confirmed launch year (Wikipedia). The 18,763 routes flown in 2014 (OpenFlights) fill each year's quota in order of earliest possible year (latest of both airports' opening and the oldest airline's founding, Wikidata; never shown before it), undated routes (6,607) are mixed in gradually from 1950 (fixed random order). A route's shown year is NOT its launch date. Airliners: ICAO commercial fleet >9 t (1988, 1997, 2006–2014) and Skybrary (1960, 'under 3,000', incl. piston); other years smoothly interpolated (monotone log-spline between sourced points), labelled. Each route newly shown in the selected year gets one plane that flies it once (max 1,500 desktop / 300 phone), then disappears. 'People within 100 km of a scheduled airport' = share of world population (HYDE 3.2 baseline popc grids, 5 arcmin, decadal 1910–2010 + 2014, linearly interpolated between grid years) living within 100 km great-circle of any endpoint airport of the routes shown that year; modelled, derived from the paced routes. Undated routes are introduced gradually from 1950 in a fixed random order.

datasets.title: When did land ownership start being recorded?
datasets.blurb: Press ▶ to watch countries, states and US counties light up as public land registers open, from Scotland's 1617 Register of Sasines to Saudi Arabia's 2002 title register.
datasets.notes: Definition: the year a public, state-run register of land ownership (a deeds registry, a title/Torrens register or an ownership cadastre) was set up for that country or unit. Tax surveys such as Domesday are excluded. Countries: dates found in the cited source this session ('documented'). US counties: the year the county was set up (Wikidata), used as a stand-in for when its recorder of deeds opened ('inferred'). Earlier deeds for that land sit with the parent county. Australian states and Canadian provinces without their own sourced date show the national value. Grey = no sourced date (No data). Government: Factbook 'Government type' grouped into 9 classes (full text in popup). Colonial ruler: ICOW primary colonial/imperial ruler (includes Ottoman, Russian and Austro-Hungarian rule) and independence date. 'Deeds under colonial rule' compares the register year with ICOW independence and is inferred. Title guarantee: state register (Torrens/HM Land Registry) vs private title insurance (US), only where sourced. Year slider applies to the land-record fields only.
